guide.name: 小方
guide.look: 一个橙色的方块小工人，戴黄色安全帽，圆圆的黑眼睛，两只短短的蓝胳膊，背着一个工具包
guide.catchphrase: 戴好安全帽，我们进去看看！
guide.image_anchor: a small orange cube-shaped builder with a yellow hard hat, round black eyes, short blue arms and a tiny tool bag

chapters.name: 第一章 · 水果城堡出事了

pages.narration: 桌上的香蕉长出了黑点点，苹果变得软软的。小方说：「戴好安全帽，我们进去看看！」

visual.description: 厨房桌面，一根带黑点的香蕉和一个有软塌塌凹坑的苹果，小方站在苹果旁边，正在扣安全帽
visual.image_prompt: A kitchen table with a spotted banana and a soft dented apple, a small orange cube-shaped builder with a yellow hard hat, round black eyes, short blue arms and a tiny tool bag stands beside the apple buckling its helmet, warm morning light, simple geometric shapes, clean flat colors

pages.narration: 原来水果是一座城堡：果皮是外墙，里面装满了糖和水，是给种子准备的粮仓。

visual.description: 苹果被剖开成一座城堡的剖面：红色外墙是果皮，里面一格格是装糖和水的仓库，正中间是种子房间，小方举着手电筒站在门口
visual.image_prompt: Cutaway view of an apple drawn as a castle, red outer wall as the peel, rooms full of sugar and water, seeds in a central chamber, a small orange cube-shaped builder with a yellow hard hat, round black eyes, short blue arms and a tiny tool bag holds a flashlight at the gate, architectural section drawing style, soft colors

follow_up.question: 为什么香蕉比苹果坏得快？
follow_up.why: 通向果皮厚薄、含水量和成熟速度

chapters.name: 第二章 · 谁在拆城堡

pages.narration: 空气里飘着看不见的霉菌孢子和细菌。它们落在果皮上，想进去吃里面的糖。

visual.description: 城堡外墙上空飘着很多小圆点和小毛球，有的落在墙上排队，小方举着放大镜看它们
visual.image_prompt: Tiny floating dots and fuzzy spores drifting in the air and landing on a red castle wall made of apple peel, a small orange cube-shaped builder with a yellow hard hat, round black eyes, short blue arms and a tiny tool bag looks at them through a magnifying glass, playful geometric style, bright daylight

pages.narration: 外墙好好的，它们进不去。可一旦磕破了、裂开了，城墙就有了大门，它们就冲进去啦。

visual.description: 城墙上有一道磕出来的裂缝，小圆点和小毛球排着队从裂缝钻进去，小方指着裂缝，表情吃惊
visual.image_prompt: A crack in a red castle wall made of apple peel, tiny dots and fuzzy spores marching through the opening into the castle, a small orange cube-shaped builder with a yellow hard hat, round black eyes, short blue arms and a tiny tool bag points at the crack looking surprised, simple shapes, clear colors

pages.narration: 霉菌一边吃一边长出毛茸茸的丝，细菌一个变两个。城堡慢慢变软、变色、变味了。

visual.description: 城堡内部，白绿色的毛茸茸细丝在房间里蔓延，小圆点一个分成两个，墙壁变成褐色、塌下去一点，小方捂着鼻子
visual.image_prompt: Inside the apple castle, white and green fuzzy threads spreading through the rooms, tiny round dots splitting into two, walls turning brown and sagging, a small orange cube-shaped builder with a yellow hard hat, round black eyes, short blue arms and a tiny tool bag holds its nose, gentle humor, geometric children's book style

follow_up.question: 那冰箱里的水果为什么坏得慢？
follow_up.why: 通向温度和微生物生长速度

chapters.name: 第三章 · 拆下来的城堡去哪了

pages.narration: 坏掉的水果落到土里，被细菌和小虫子拆成很小很小的碎块，变成泥土里的养分。

visual.description: 地面剖面：上面是一个塌掉的苹果，下面土层里有小虫子和小圆点在搬运碎块，碎块流向一棵小苗的根，小方蹲在土里看
visual.image_prompt: Ground section drawing, a collapsed apple on the soil surface, below it earthworms and tiny dots carrying small pieces down to the roots of a young seedling, a small orange cube-shaped builder with a yellow hard hat, round black eyes, short blue arms and a tiny tool bag crouches in the soil watching, earthy warm colors, simple geometric shapes

pages.narration: 所以水果要轻拿轻放，放在凉快的地方。小方说：「拆城堡的工人，也是盖新家的工人。」

visual.description: 回到厨房，小方小心地把一个完好的苹果放进果篮，旁边的窗台上有一盆刚冒芽的小苗
visual.image_prompt: Back in the kitchen, a small orange cube-shaped builder with a yellow hard hat, round black eyes, short blue arms and a tiny tool bag gently places a shiny whole apple into a fruit basket, a small sprouting plant on the windowsill behind, calm afternoon light, clean flat geometric style

follow_up.question: 霉菌是从哪里来的？
follow_up.why: 通向孢子、真菌和它们在自然里的分解作用

child_page.prompt: 你还想知道什么？说给爸爸妈妈听，他们会帮你写在这里。

hard_notes: 水果腐烂主要是微生物（霉菌、酵母、细菌）在分解果肉里的糖和细胞壁。
果皮是物理屏障，磕碰和裂口让微生物更容易进入；水果自身的酶和乙烯也会让它继续成熟、变软，熟过头后更容易被侵入。
低温能同时减慢微生物生长和水果自身的代谢，所以冰箱里坏得慢。

sources.title: Food spoilage（Wikipedia）
sources.used_for: 微生物导致腐败、温度的作用

uncertain: 书里把「拆城堡」都算在外来的微生物头上，其实水果自己的酶也在分解自己，为了讲清楚省掉了这一层。
没有区分霉菌和细菌，两者都画成了「工人」；孩子追问时可以再分开讲。
parent_card.weekend_project: 拿两个苹果，一个轻轻磕一下，一个完好，都放在室温下，每天拍一张照片，看哪个先出现褐色斑点。
